_comment: Factions (docs/FACTIONS.md). id: {name, start (a new character's standing, -20000..20000), kill (standing change for killing one of its members, default -50), allies: ids that change the same way as this one when its members die (and enemies the other way)}. A mob joins a faction with "faction": id in mobs.json. Quests and parleys can reward {"faction": {id: amount}}. Placeholder data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md).
